subject: FinWell onboarding sprint: stitch console & API enablement
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finwell.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@finwell.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: FinWell onboarding sprint & split enablement plan

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — Samir and I liked the console flow and the latency profiles you shared. We want to move to a short onboarding sprint next month to get both console walkthroughs for product managers and an API deep-dive for our platform engineers.

High level ask: can we split enablement into two focus blocks (Console: 2.5 hours, API + integration: 2.5 hours) across consecutive days, or would you recommend a different cadence?

Proposed dates (Pacific):
- Option A: Wed Jul 11 (console) + Thu Jul 12 (API) 9:00–11:30 PT
- Option B: Tue Jul 17 (console) + Wed Jul 18 (API) 13:00–15:30 PT

Prereqs from our side: access to a sandbox tenant, a short sample dataset (PII redacted), and a service account for API keys. Procurement is keen to lock dates quickly — there is a contract review window that may require sessions to start before Jul 25.

I attached our internal onboarding checklist so you can see what we'll need on day one (FinWell_ACM_requirements.pdf). Also looping Samir — he may want to include a cross-functional engineer for the API session.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez | Head of Platform Integrations
FinWell

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 12:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FinWell onboarding sprint & split enablement plan

Alicia —

Appreciate the checklist, that helps. We can do the split you suggested but recommend a slightly different cadence to reduce fatigue for engineers: three focused blocks instead of two — Console (90m), API deep-dive (90m), and a 60m integration lab where we pair on your sample dataset. That gives the engineering team hands-on time to validate tokenization, request/response shapes, and a quick KV/cache demo.

Our availability (PT):
- Mon Jul 10: console 9:00–10:30 PT, API 11:00–12:30 PT
- Wed Jul 12: integration lab 9:00–10:00 PT

If procurement needs sessions before Jul 25 we can prioritize earlier slots next week.

I've attached a first draft of a mutual action plan so we can lock owners and deliverables (mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx).

Marissa will lead the console walkthrough and Karthik will own the API deep-dive + lab. Can you confirm the final attendee list (names + roles) and whether your infra team will provision an IAM service account or if you want Redwood to create a temporary key for the sandbox?

If you prefer a single two-day run, we can compress — just let us know.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Sent from my mobile

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finwell.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinWell onboarding sprint & split enablement plan

Hi Alicia —

Quick note from the enablement side: Ben's three-block approach is my recommendation as well. Proposed leads and objectives below: 

1) Console walkthrough (90m) — lead: Marissa Cole (redwood.enablement)
   - Objectives: Console navigation, model selection, runtime toggles, monitoring/alerts, cost breakdowns.
   - Deliverable: runbook + short recorded clips for your PMs.

2) API deep-dive (90m) — lead: Karthik Iyer (redwood.platform)
   - Objectives: auth, SDK vs REST, batching controls, KV cache, examples for embedding + reranking.
   - Deliverable: post-session snippet repo and example curl/snippets.

3) Integration lab (60m) — lead: Karthik + Marissa
   - Objectives: end-to-end request from sample dataset, validate sample prompts, and confirm tokenization/throughput targets.

I uploaded a short runbook template to the shared drive (see link) and prefilled owner tasks — please add your internal owners there: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefFinWellRunbook

Also sent our SSO/SSO provisioning DocuSign that covers the service account handshake. If procurement needs a signed statement before workshops we can accelerate that doc.

Thanks — I’ll stand by for attendee names and final dates so we can send invites and prep links.

– Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enablement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finwell.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@finwell.com>, Procurement <procurement@finwell.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinWell onboarding sprint & split enablement plan

Thanks Ben/Marissa — this looks good. Procurement flagged that they need a short SOC/KYC packet completed before engineering can provision service accounts; I've attached the security questionnaire your team requested (security_questionnaire.xlsx).

Attendees confirmed for now (will add extras as needed):
- Alicia Gomez — Head of Platform Integrations (FinWell)
- Samir Patel — CTO (FinWell)
- Rina Cho — Senior Engineer (FinWell)
- Marcus Lee — Product Manager (FinWell)

We prefer the week of Jul 10 to Jul 14 if you can accommodate — Option: Mon Jul 10 morning PT for console + Tue Jul 11 morning for API + Wed Jul 12 morning for the lab. Procurement will prioritize the DocuSign envelope if you share it.

A quick ask: can you provide a short pre-session checklist (account invites, test dataset format, expected IAM scopes) so our infra team can parallelize tasks?

Thanks,
Alicia

Alicia —

Great, we’ll lock in the week of Jul 10. Proposed calendar bake (all times PT):

- Tue Jul 11 09:00–10:30 — API deep-dive (Karthik)
- Wed Jul 12 09:00–10:00 — Integration lab (Marissa + Karthik)

Action items for FinWell:
